## About

RevivalMD Aesthetic Clinic is a physician-led medical spa with two locations in Rahway (Union County) and Fair Lawn (Bergen County), NJ. Founded by Dr. Haroon Arshad, MD, MBA, Dr. M. Miz. Haque, MD, MHA, and Sanna Arshad, PA-C, MHA. They combine primary care expertise with aesthetic medicine, emphasizing personalized consultations over sales pitches.

---

## Services

- Botox & Letybo injections (wrinkles
- TMJ
- hyperhidrosis)
- Dermal fillers
- Laser hair removal (80-90% permanent reduction)
- Microneedling
- RF Microneedling
- RF Therapy
- PRP injections
- PRP Biofiller
- Exosome therapy
- IV Therapy
- Aquafirme facials
- IPL
- TRT
- Vitamin B & D injections
- Medical weight loss (GLP-1)

## What Sets Us Apart

- Physician-led care (board-certified physicians)
- Two NJ locations (Rahway + Fair Lawn)
- Multilingual team (English, Urdu, Hindi, Punjabi, Spanish)
- Natural-looking results, never frozen
- Transparent pricing with flexible payment

## Key Facts & Team

- Dr. Haroon Arshad (MD, MBA - medical director)

- Sanna Arshad (PA-C, MHA - 9+ years aesthetic)

- Affiliated: Bergen New Bridge Medical Center, The Valley Hospital

Adults 25-55 in northern/central NJ seeking non-surgical aesthetic treatments. Both cosmetic and medical indication seekers (TMJ, hyperhidrosis). Multilingual patients.
